name: starting_paragon_level
notes: ruling 2026-09-28; account-mode floor on character creation; 0 disables the floor.

name: respec_cooldown_ms
notes: security.md G1; brief docs/briefs/claude-combat-security-fixes-brief.md (ruling 2026-09-30) says about 1 second; D3 respec is free so this is the only brake; 0 disables it.

name: allocate_gap_ms
notes: security.md G1 gaps; brief docs/briefs/claude-combat-g1-gaps-brief.md (ruling 2026-09-30) says start around 100-250; least time between two Paragon allocate or deallocate requests from one character - each waits for a database commit; 150 still lets a held button repeat about 6 times a second; 0 disables it

name: paragon_save_interval_ms
notes: ruling 2026-10-09 (diablocraft-7f36; docs/decisions.md 2026-10-09). Most often the Paragon XP of an account is written to the database while it keeps changing; a kill only changes memory. A Paragon level-up, a rift's closing XP, the last logout of the account, the creation floor and shutdown write at once. A server crash loses at most this much Paragon XP. 0 or blank writes at the next server tick
